title: platform-checklist: add `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu`, the acceptance item of objectui#10188 (a doc on the app menu follows the reader's audience; the direct route refuses)
body:
Routed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) as the cross-repo half of objectstack-ai/objectui#10188. Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are this repo's triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

- objectui#10188 is the objectui half of ruling batch #206 item 1 letter A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19482 (the maintainer: 「doc 包文档 我觉得是有需求的，可能管理员需要在界面上写一些markdown的文档。甚至加到菜单。」), with the director's addendum `5754645447`. Its Acceptance asks for "a platform-checklist item authored with this card", and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` lists that row as 「清单项待写」 beside `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` and `platform-core.docs-portal-render`.
- The objectui work has landed:
  - the doc editor: PR objectui#11241 (`02fe8ca8a0`);
  - the menu's renderer pruning, as defence in depth behind objectstack#19790's server pruning (that ruling's point 2), plus the portal's direct-route refusal and the claiming-book permalink: PR objectui#11258 (d6a1a80d5d).
- The item below was drafted by that card's dev and measured live on a published `@objectstack/cli` 17.5.0 backend, as written. It was then corrected by the at-tier review of PR objectui#11258 (`5919164226`, ③ (h)):
  - the UI-mirror clause is scoped to entries that name an installed doc or book (a dangling `{ doc }` entry the server still serves may be hidden by the renderer);
  - the signed-out persona is dropped: `/docs` sits behind `ProtectedRoute` in the console, so a signed-out reader never reaches the portal.
